title: Onramp Pathfinder: modular checklist tiles & empty-state tip patterns
creator: Daniel Kim
description: Design and deliver a modular set of onboarding "onramp" tiles, checklist states, and empty-state tips for first-run flows in the Console. Focus on compact tile grid, progressive disclosure for advanced settings, keyboard accessibility, and screenshot-ready variants for release notes. Deliverables include Figma components, exported SVGs, motion specs for subtle entrance animations, and a library of screenshot canvases for Marketing/Docs.
microcopy_variants: Welcome aboard — pick a quick start to connect a model
Start here: create your first endpoint or try a sample request
Tip: pin a model for consistent latency across requests (learn more)
Pro-tip: enable KV cache for faster conversational turns
accessibility_notes: All tiles must have focusable region with visible focus ring (2px high-contrast)
Implement aria-labels that summarize action and state (e.g., 'Create endpoint — recommended')
Color contrast audited to AA for text and icons; example tokens provided in Figma
Keyboard order matches visual left-to-right, top-to-bottom flow
constraints_and_tradeoffs: Compact grid limits line-height; reduce copy to single-sentence per tile to avoid truncation
Animated entrance introduces extra rendering on first-run; cap to 200ms and provide prefers-reduced-motion fallback
Screenshot variants require artificial data placeholders (model name, cost estimates) that must be scrubbed for security before public release
tasks: Create Figma component with 3 tile sizes (compact, standard, large)
Export SVG sprite and prepare retina PNG fallbacks for marketing
Author microcopy package with short + long variants and localization keys
Implement motion spec and add reduced-motion states
Coordinate with Frontend ENG for CSS tokens and focus styles
Produce 6 release-ready screenshots and upload to Drive
